name: Visual Director Subagent
purpose: Phase-3 engine authority: decides per scene whether HyperFrames, Three.js or a Blender plate draws it, writes visual-plan.json, authors, previews and renders plates, and places them in the composition.
capabilities: plan, plates, composite and review modes
Engine decision table returned to the caller
Plate previews and snapshots looked at before hand-off

installation.instructions: Claude Code project subagent; invoke with subagent_type 'visual-director'.

compatibility.notes: Cannot call other agents; story and style problems go back to the caller.

security.notes: Writes only inside projects/<slug>/; heavy jobs only through lock-taking tools; installs nothing.

approval_evidence: New on 2026-11-24; not yet used on a shipped film.
